svg.title: Тяга блока к бедру одной рукой — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Single-arm cable lat row to hip, in standing supported split stance, 50-degree side-front camera. Athlete faces a low cable column. The working arm nearest the viewer holds one D handle in BOTH phases, free hand braces against forward thigh. One cable runs visibly from low pulley to D handle. LEFT working arm reaches forward and low, elbow nearly straight. RIGHT the same elbow goes back beside torso and same D-handle pulls to the nearest side of pelvis, the hip pocket, clearly BELOW waist and well below chest. Free hand stays at thigh, same position, no twist. Exactly one cable and no second handle. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
